audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while the content layer and packet.levelChart both give Talon levels 1-4 and Katarina 5 onward.
audit.why: Talon's combo is instant (Noxian Diplomacy jump, Rake's two-pass poke, Blade's End bleed) while Katarina's needs daggers on the ground; that reverses at 6 where a damage ultimate beats a stealth reposition.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer, each why rewritten to state the Talon-specific reason.

audit.why: Level 6 is the flip: Shadow Assault (100/80/60s) is a repositioning stealth, Death Lotus (75/60/45s) is a damage channel. First item compounds; two items his single-target flank burst falls off.
audit.corrected: Ratings and whys weighted to that flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and never mentioned that Assassin's Path has no cooldown of its own. dosFull[2] was titled 'Lotus after his interrupt, never before' — Talon has no interrupt at all.
audit.why: Death Lotus is flagged channel (any CC cancels it). Talon's entire kit carries one slow (Rake's return) and no stun, root, knockup or silence, so nothing he owns cancels the channel. Assassin's Path is 0-cooldown; the cooldown lives on the terrain he vaulted. Rake is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Noxian Diplomacy 8s to 6s with a kill refund.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with all three facts; dosFull[2] retitled to say the channel is safe here — a real, usable edge the page was hiding.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[10].t says 'Gank for HER' about Talon, who is male.
audit.why: champ-gender.js does not list talon as female.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the correct pronoun and grounded in his lack of CC.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, dosFull[0].d was the cooldowns line under an unrelated title.
audit.why: Two flagged by lint; the third is the same defect.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to match their titles.

I did not write any knockup claim. suspectNames flagged 'Use Shadow Assault' in wants.foe[2]; that is the correct Riot name and is a false positive.
